LR-CONVERGENCE iter (framing A: give the gentle lr more steps). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY iter->hr: 1->0.0508 (lr0.01,ep6,8params,335s), 2(ep18@lr0.01)->0.0337 (epochs INERT AT lr0.01, hr FELL), 3(n_bands6)->0.0, 4(n_outer2)->0.0 (SSIM 0.6459 COLLAPSED), 5(train_n480,ep3)->0.0411 (data FAILED), 6(lr 0.01->0.003,ep6)->0.0966 NEW BEST (SSIM 0.8232, 334.8s), 7(lr 0.003->0.001,ep6)->0.0668 REGRESSED (SSIM 0.8022, 350.4s). THE lr/EPOCHS INTERACTION: lr0.01->0.003 nearly DOUBLED hr (0.0508->0.0966), but the further drop lr0.003->0.001 at the SAME ep6 REGRESSED to 0.0668 -- at ep6 the smaller lr0.001 UNDER-CONVERGED, it did not reach the basin lr0.003 found in 6 steps. Base copied = iter-7 (lr0.001). (2) LIMITER: the lr0.001 basin is UNDER-CONVERGED at ep6 -- iter-7 fired its own falsifier (hr 0.0668 <= 0.0966 at lr0.001/ep6 => RAISE EPOCHS to let the smaller lr converge BEFORE declaring the lr axis exhausted; do NOT yet file the FBP-ceiling verdict). Note iter-2 proved ep INERT at lr0.01 -- but that is the FAST lr that saturates the clamped scalars by ep1; at the 10x-gentler lr0.001 epochs are NOT presumed inert, they are the missing convergence budget. (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 6 -> 18 (3x) AT lr0.001 (iter-7 base, UNCHANGED). Sole change. PARAM COUNT UNCHANGED at 8 (wu_n_bands=4 + 2 + 2*wu_n_outer=1). wu_n_outer=1 (MANDATORY), grad_clip=1.0, wu_n_bands=4 all held. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if iter-7 was lr0.001-UNDER-CONVERGENCE-limited at ep6, giving it 18 epochs lets lr0.001 settle into a basin that lifts hr ABOVE the iter-6 best 0.0966 (breast-CT TPE precedent: wu hr0.317 at ~10x-lower lr suggests gentler-lr headroom IF converged). PREDICTED iter-8 hr ~0.10-0.13. NUMERIC FALSIFIER (terminal): if hr <= 0.0966 (at/below iter-6 best) EVEN at ep18, then lr0.001 cannot beat lr0.003 even GIVEN 3x the steps -- the lr AND epochs axes are BOTH exhausted; file the FBP-family ceiling verdict (epochs inert, bands regressed, outer-depth collapsed, data failed, lr-floor+epochs exhausted => Wu-trainable caps hr~0.10 on real-helical Mayo, no image-domain learned CNN denoiser, far below dual-domain U-Net families hr~0.27). (5) BUDGET (HARD 1200s/20-min train+score): iter-7 ep6=350.4s. Worst-case PESSIMISTIC (treat ALL 350s as scaling with epochs, over-counts since the 214-slice val pass is a FIXED per-iter cost): 350.4 * 18/6 = 1051s < 1200s HARD and << 1800s SLURM kill; realistically only the train portion scales (val fixed) so ep18 sits well under. val FIGURE outside budget. val_n=214 = ALL L277 slices (do NOT reduce); grad_clip=1.0 (MANDATORY Mayo guard -- 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise); bs=1 + val_chunk=1 forced by per-sample-ps; staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted; per-sample-ps FBP + per-sample model.proj/model.dense_proj swap; bg_target=truth; 321px detector-geometry FOV default (NO fov override); wu_n_outer=1 (MANDATORY). (6) no control return.
